assumptions: The login popup is represented by the existing locator 'welcome_login_f' and dismissed via 'maybe_later'.
No existing locator matches a generic 'first autosuggest suggestion' element, so a new element name 'FirstAutosuggestOption' was introduced for that step.
The search input field on the homepage corresponds to the existing locator 'search_box'.

testcases.expected: Login popup is dismissed via maybe_later, the search term is entered in the search box, and the first autosuggest suggestion is selected leading to the corresponding results page.
preconditions: Browser is open and cookies cleared
steps: Verify that element welcome_login_f is displayed
testcases.title: Search for baldev engineering after dismissing login popup

testcases.expected: When the login popup does not appear, the search term is entered directly and the first autosuggest suggestion is selected leading to the corresponding results page.
preconditions: Browser is open and cookies cleared
steps: Verify that element welcome_login_f is not displayed
testcases.title: Search for baldev engineering when login popup is not shown

unclear: Whether the popup should be checked with a wait step before verifying its display state, since the request implies conditional visibility but framework steps are deterministic.

prompt:
www.justdial.com
if login popup seen then click 
maybe_later else
search for baldev engineering
& select  first autosuggest
